steps.text: Meet Rex and Rook in Dash's lab in the Far Future, and pull the Swap-o-Tron's lever. Rex wants his own body back.
The swap's knotted into the Agent of Chaos's cracked clock. Stop his clock: he's in the far field behind the castle hill.

reward.message: His clock's stopped, and the knot in the Shift has come loose. Rex and Dash have something to tell you, soon... (+10 sparkles)
